scope: Controlled same-album experiment: both reference targets and independent held-out targets come from the same deterministic global prompt renderer. The first reference is the existing group representative, and the second is the first different photo in the recorded group order. Both references are excluded from evaluation. Fit separately and average polynomial coefficients. Groups are not verified, and generated targets are not human edits. Reduced-resolution RGB RMSE is not visual or professional quality. This test does not evaluate face-relative or frame-relative edits or automatic normalization.

runs.prompt: warm and slightly soft contrast and lift shadows
cool and strong contrast and deepen shadows
warmer and reduce highlights and muted blues
